name: Perphenazine Enanthate
summary: Perphenazine enanthate is a long-acting injectable (depot) form of the older antipsychotic perphenazine. It is injected into a muscle and releases the medicine slowly over time, so you don’t need daily pills.
description: Perphenazine enanthate is a long-acting injectable (depot) form of the phenothiazine antipsychotic perphenazine. It is injected into a muscle and releases the drug slowly over time, which keeps levels in the blood steady and makes it easier to stay on treatment for people who need long-term antipsychotic medicine. It works mainly by blocking dopamine D2 receptors in the brain, reducing symptoms of psychosis.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Perphenazine enanthate is a depot formulation of the phenothiazine antipsychotic perphenazine. It is designed for intramuscular injection, providing a sustained release of the drug over time, which helps maintain consistent plasma levels and improves adherence in patients requiring long-term antipsychotic therapy. It works primarily by blocking dopamine D2 receptors in the brain, reducing symptoms of psychosis.
